messages:
maya: quick FYI — planning to land a small convo schema change tonight 02:00 UTC. It makes response.role optional (server can omit for assistant auto-role). Want quick compatibility checks for streaming clients / SDKs.
sam: thanks. which endpoints? chat.completions only or also convo history?
maya: chat.completions + streaming deltas. No change to toolcall shape. Only the top-level message.role field may be omitted in assistant messages.
leo: can we see sample payload? also any change to end-of-stream behavior?
maya: snippet:
```json
{
  "id": "xyz",
  "messages": [{"role": "assistant", "content": "hi"}]
}
```
becomes
```json
{
  "id": "xyz",
  "messages": [{"content": "hi"}]
}
```
ashley: SDKs should tolerate missing role — most already default to assistant. but confirm streaming delta 'role' chunk may be absent midstream.
maya: yes — streaming may emit initial delta chunks without role. Clients should treat missing role as 'assistant' when content arrives unless `role` present earlier.
infra-bot: deploy window approved 02:00-02:30 UTC, canary 5% for 10min, auto-rollback on error rate >0.5%
sam: recording an action: sdk-team to add explicit test for "missing role in streaming initial chunks" — assigning to @sam.
sam: pinging @zane for runtime howler: does routing need change for compatibility?
zane: no route changes. runtime already tolerant. just ensure schema lint accepts nullable role field.
maya: cool. can folks +1 if their client is ok? otherwise we'll hold.
leo: +1 (android and web tested)
ashley: +1 (python sdk)
sam: i'll add test PR during my lunch, expect before deploy.
maya: thanks all. will post final deploy link and rollback plan before 01:45 UTC. :rocket:
